name: peoplevault
description: Workforce privacy and data lifecycle governance for synthetic workforce data

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p tsconfig.web.json
scripts.policy:compile: uv run --project pipelines pv policy compile
scripts.eval:deletion: uv run --project pipelines pv eval deletion --profile full
scripts.eval:deletion:ci: uv run --project pipelines pv eval deletion --profile ci
scripts.eval:authz: vitest run --project worker test/worker/authz.cases.test.ts --reporter=default --reporter=json --outputFile.json=.dev/authz-pdp.json && uv run --project pipelines pv authz warehouse --target local --write-results --pdp-report .dev/authz-pdp.json
scripts.authz:prod: uv run --project pipelines pv authz api --target prod --write-results
scripts.authz:api:local: uv run --project pipelines pv authz api --target local --start --allow-writes --write-results
